h.en: Gold edges back above US$4,050 after CPI sell-off
h.zh: CPI 抛售后金价回升至 4,050 美元上方

f.en: Spot gold was at US$4,057.33/oz at 06:37 GMT on 11 Nov, up about 0.6%, after Tuesday's near-3% drop. Analysts called it a technical bounce rather than a turn.
f.zh: 11月11日格林尼治时间 06:37 现货金报 4,057.33 美元/盎司，涨约 0.6%；周二曾跌近 3%。分析师认为这是技术性反弹而非趋势逆转。

i.en: A rebound after a sharp fall can fade if rate-hike expectations stay high; buyers may see choppy prices this week.
i.zh: 大跌后的反弹在加息预期高企时可能难以持续，本周价格或较波动。

h.en: US October CPI comes in hotter than expected
h.zh: 美国10月 CPI 高于预期

f.en: Headline CPI rose 0.4% m/m (forecast 0.3%) and core rose 0.3% (forecast 0.2%). No year-on-year figure was published for October because of the 2025 shutdown data gap.
f.zh: 整体 CPI 环比升 0.4%（预期 0.3%），核心 CPI 升 0.3%（预期 0.2%）。因 2025 年政府停摆缺少数据，10月未公布同比数字。

i.en: Sticky inflation keeps pressure on the Fed to raise rates, which tends to weigh on non-yielding gold.
i.zh: 通胀黏性令美联储维持加息压力，通常不利于无息的黄金。

h.en: Gold falls nearly 3% as dollar and yields climb
h.zh: 美元及收益率上升，金价跌近 3%

f.en: Spot gold was down 2.8% at US$4,021.36 at 11:33 a.m. ET. A 25 bp December hike was seen as fully priced, and the odds of a 50 bp move rose to about 10.5%.
f.zh: 美东时间上午 11:33 现货金跌 2.8% 至 4,021.36 美元。市场已完全计入12月加息 25 个基点，加息 50 个基点概率升至约 10.5%。

i.en: Higher US rates and a firmer dollar raise the cost of holding gold and make it dearer for non-USD buyers.
i.zh: 美国利率上升和美元走强提高持有黄金的成本，并使非美元买家购金更贵。

h.en: Fed's Waller backs a December hike, floats half-point option
h.zh: 美联储沃勒支持12月加息，并提及可加息半个百分点

f.en: Governor Christopher Waller said the Fed should raise rates next month and consider 50 bp if inflation worsens; FedWatch showed about 99% odds of a hike before the CPI release.
f.zh: 理事沃勒表示美联储下月应加息，若通胀恶化可考虑加息 50 个基点；CPI 公布前 FedWatch 显示加息概率约 99%。

i.en: Hawkish Fed talk lifts short-term yields, a headwind for gold in USD and in pegged HKD and AED.
i.zh: 美联储鹰派言论推高短期收益率，对以美元及挂钩的港元、迪拉姆计价的金价构成阻力。

h.zh: CPI 公布后美国10年期国债收益率突破 5%

f.en: The 10-year Treasury yield moved above 5% and markets priced a 100% chance of a hike at the 8–9 Dec meeting (88% for 25 bp, 12% for 50 bp). Brent fell to about US$91.
f.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率升破 5%，市场计入12月8–9日会议 100% 加息概率（25 个基点 88%，50 个基点 12%）。布伦特原油跌至约 91 美元。

i.en: Yields above 5% make bonds a stronger rival to gold; cheaper oil partly offsets this by easing inflation fears.
i.zh: 收益率逾 5% 使债券对黄金的竞争力增强；油价下跌缓解通胀担忧，可部分抵消。

h.en: Ringgit flat at 4.054–4.059 vs US dollar

f.en: The ringgit opened at 4.0540/0590 per USD, unchanged from Tuesday, but firmer against the yen, euro and pound. Bank Muamalat expected a 4.06–4.08 range for the day.
f.zh: 马币开盘报 4.0540/0590 兑 1 美元，与周二持平，但兑日元、欧元和英镑走强。马来西亚回教银行预计当日在 4.06–4.08 区间。

i.en: With the ringgit steady, RM gold prices largely follow the USD spot price; a weaker ringgit would add slightly to local prices.
i.zh: 马币稳定时令吉金价主要跟随美元现货；若马币走弱，本地金价会略升。

h.en: Economist sees room for ringgit to strengthen in 2027
h.zh: 经济学家认为马币 2027 年有走强空间

f.en: Juwai IQI's Shan Saeed gave a 2027 base case of RM3.90–4.11 per USD, citing chip and data-centre investment. BNM held the OPR at 2.75% on 5 Nov.
f.zh: 居外 IQI 首席经济学家 Shan Saeed 给出 2027 年基准区间 3.90–4.11 令吉兑 1 美元，理由是芯片和数据中心投资。国行11月5日维持 OPR 2.75%。

i.en: A stronger ringgit over time would make gold slightly cheaper in RM, all else equal; this is a forecast, not a certainty.
i.zh: 若马币中期走强，其他条件不变下以令吉计金价会略降；此为预测，并非定论。

h.en: Dubai 24K rises to AED 496.75/g as oil eases
h.zh: 油价回落，迪拜 24K 金价升至每克 496.75 迪拉姆

f.en: Dubai Jewellery Group data showed 24K at AED 496.75/g and 22K at AED 460 at Monday's open, up from AED 490.50 over the weekend.
f.zh: 迪拜珠宝集团数据显示周一开盘 24K 每克 496.75 迪拉姆，22K 每克 460 迪拉姆，周末为 490.50。

i.en: Rates set before Tuesday's CPI drop; Dubai prices track USD spot almost one-for-one because of the AED peg.
i.zh: 该价格早于周二 CPI 引发的下跌；由于迪拉姆挂钩美元，迪拜金价几乎与现货同步。

h.en: Mainland buyers lift Hong Kong jewellery sales 22%
h.zh: 内地买家带动香港珠宝销售增长 22%

f.en: Hong Kong sales of jewellery, watches and valuable gifts rose 22% y/y to HK$45.8bn in the first nine months of 2026, the highest since 2019.
f.zh: 2026 年前九个月香港珠宝、钟表及贵重礼品销售同比增 22% 至 458 亿港元，为 2019 年以来最高。

i.en: Strong local demand supports retail premiums in Hong Kong even when spot prices dip.
i.zh: 本地需求强劲，即使现货回落，香港零售溢价仍获支撑。

h.en: Central banks buy gold at fastest pace since 2024
h.zh: 各国央行购金速度为 2024 年以来最快

f.en: World Gold Council: central banks bought 321 t in Q3 2026, 42% above a year earlier.
f.zh: 世界黄金协会：2026 年第三季度央行购金 321 吨，同比增 42%。

i.en: Steady official buying is a longer-term support; it rarely drives day-to-day moves.
i.zh: 官方持续购金是长期支撑因素，但很少主导日内波动。
